semantic_summary.one_sentence_summary: The recording features 22 vocal phrases with variable durations and three distinct recurring motifs centered around an A#3 tonal center, exhibiting mostly flat to descending melodic contours with a vocal cycle tempo near 18 bpm but low confidence.
semantic_summary.structure_description: The vocal pattern comprises 22 phrases divided into extended, short vocal calls, standard, and compact phrases, interspersed with short, micro, and extended pauses. The vocal density is high (~0.94) with low silence density (~0.04). Phrase durations vary widely (mean ~6.76s), with a low tempo stability and low confidence on cycle tempo estimation. Three main motifs were identified, repeating 2 to 6 times each, covering about two-thirds of phrases.
semantic_summary.dominant_pattern: Dominant motifs (motif_001, motif_007, motif_003) show descending and mostly flat pitch contours centered around A#3 and G#3 with durations ranging from ~3.5s to ~18.7s; melodic contour is mostly flat or descending.
